build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run runtime:prepare && bun run skills:check && bun run typecheck && bun run worker:check && bash ../../scripts/with-release-env.sh bun run build && bun run agent:build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://briar-api.wbai.workers.dev https://raw.githubusercontent.com; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https: data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Monitor Briar issue processing from iOS
bundle.longDescription: Briar Companion monitors issue processing and queues new issues for a connected Briar desktop agent.
